_comment: Mobile-carrier ASNs: carrier-NAT address space with no servers, so on its own it counts as last mile (server/access-data.ts). Only ASNs whose registry record names a mobile/wireless network are listed; each entry's `source` is the registry record checked (ARIN RDAP rdap.arin.net/registry/autnum/<asn>, APNIC RDAP rdap.apnic.net/autnum/<asn>) on 2026-10-22, cross-checked against the APNIC Labs per-AS end-user estimates (stats.labs.apnic.net/aspop). Mixed fixed+mobile+datacenter ASNs (e.g. the China Mobile CMNET ASNs, which also carry fixed broadband) are deliberately left out. PeeringDB has no mobile network type (T-Mobile US is listed as Cable/DSL/ISP), so this list can't be derived from it.

21928.source: ARIN RDAP: AS21928 name T-MOBILE-AS21928, registrant T-Mobile USA, Inc.; APNIC Labs aspop: ~18.9M US users

6167.source: ARIN RDAP: AS6167 name CELLCO-PART, registrant Verizon Business (Cellco Partnership is the Verizon Wireless legal entity); APNIC Labs aspop: ~17.9M US users

22394.source: ARIN RDAP: AS22394 name CELLCO, registrant Verizon Business (Cellco Partnership is the Verizon Wireless legal entity)

20057.source: ARIN RDAP: AS20057 name ATT-MOBILITY-LLC-AS20057, registrant AT&T Enterprises, LLC; APNIC Labs aspop: ~0.6M US users

45609.source: APNIC RDAP: AS45609 name BHARTI-MOBILITY-AS-AP, remark 'Bharti Airtel Ltd. AS for GPRS Service'; APNIC Labs aspop: ~152M IN users

131445.source: APNIC RDAP: AS131445 name AIS3G-2100-AS-AP, remark 'Advance Wireless Network'; APNIC Labs aspop: ~10.2M TH users
